message: none of the 4 element(s) that carry a name, nor any of the 1 group(s) around them
$reason: The reference's triggers and panel with the consumer's name taken off them, and handed instead, with a stop, to a directive on an `<ng-container>`. Bound on a container, `[tabIndex]`, `[ariaLabel]` and `[ariaLabelledby]` compile only where a directive takes them as inputs (NG8002, measured with `ngc` 22.2.1), and the container draws a comment, which no user lands on and nothing names. Read as an element, the container was a stop carrying both names, and the template passed point 4 with no control named; read with no stop, as a projection is, it is no carrier, and none of the elements that are binds the name.
